dcterms:description: A toy dataset of sentences generated from a context-free grammar (CFG) designed to evaluate language generation models. It includes biased and unbiased sentences, with a vocabulary of 840 words and a maximum sentence length of 19 symbols.
dcterms:title: Toy Dataset of Sentences

dcterms:description: The GuessWhat?! dataset consists of sentences asked by humans to humans to solve a cooperative game. It features a vocabulary of 10,469 words, with a maximum sentence length of 57 symbols.
dcterms:title: GuessWhat?! Dataset
